project.title: DND DPDCS SMMS Replacement Project

role_overview.summary: The Department of National Defence's (DND) DPDCS division manages critical operational systems supporting Search and Rescue (SAR) coordination across Canada. Christian served as Cloud Architect for Resilient Systems over a 22-month Agile engagement on the SMMS Replacement Project to replace the legacy SARMASTER hardware and software platform with a resilient AWS architecture capable of 24/7 high availability, Geographic Information System (GIS) and live-data integration, and reliable backup-site capability. He architected the segmented multi-VPC AWS network and containerized application and data platform, built reusable AWS CloudFormation and AWS Service Catalog environment automation alongside integrated CI/CD delivery pipelines, and engineered the defense-in-depth security and access control posture aligned to Information Technology Security Guidance (ITSG-33), DND, and Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (TBS) cloud compliance requirements. Across the engagement, his work reduced on-demand environment provisioning from weeks to hours, established a zero-downtime migration strategy, and produced pre-migratory security reporting to support interim Authority to Operate (iATO) readiness.

challenge.summary: The Department of National Defence's (DND) DPDCS division operated national Search and Rescue (SAR) management on the aging SARMASTER platform, which lacked cloud resilience, Geographic Information System (GIS) integration, live-data interface capability, and a viable long-term support path. The replacement platform required 24/7 high availability, backup-site capability, and alignment to Information Technology Security Guidance (ITSG-33), DND, and Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (TBS) cloud security requirements within a 22-month delivery window.

deliverables: Multi-VPC AWS Network and Containerized SAR Platform Architecture
Infrastructure as Code, AWS Service Catalog, and CI/CD Automation
ITSG-33 Security Controls, Access Posture, and iATO Readiness

outcomes: Reduced on-demand environment provisioning for development, testing, production, and disaster replay from weeks to hours using AWS Service Catalog products
Architected a Multi-AZ containerized AWS platform using Docker, Amazon ECS, and PostgreSQL with a zero-downtime migration strategy to support 24/7 Search and Rescue operations across Canada

Aligned security controls, access posture, and pre-migratory security reporting to ITSG-33, DND, and Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (TBS) cloud requirements toward interim Authority to Operate (iATO)
